description: Eight knobs in 4HP, each holding a fixed voltage at its own jack, with a mute button and a polyphonic jack carrying all eight

params.text: Replaces every output with the mute voltage while it is held, or until the next press when its latch button is on
Makes the mute button a toggle, one press muting and the next unmuting, in place of a mute that lasts while the button is held
Sets that section's voltage, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise

outputs.text: Carries one channel per section, each at that section's voltage
Carries the voltage set by the knob beside it

notes: muted outputs go to 0V unless you pick another level under Mute voltage, and the one setting applies to all eight sections
menu: Mute voltage — sets the voltage every output carries while the mute button is on, 0V unless you change it
Set knobs 1-8 — sets all eight knobs at once to a named set, among them a run of semitone intervals and a spread of negative and positive volts
Set as scale — sets the eight knobs to the degrees of a named scale, as volts per octave
Set as chord — sets the eight knobs to the notes of a named chord, as volts per octave
Poly output channels: 1 (monophonic) up to 8 channels — sets how many of the eight sections the POLY jack carries, 8 unless you reduce it
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
